title: Measure how many round-1 Haiku review FAILs are noise
why: Round-1 reviewers run Haiku (decision agent-model-cap, reviewer row). Haiku round 1 fails 79% of records against 38% for Sonnet, but how many of those FAILs name no real defect is unknown. Each noise FAIL costs a fix round. The owner item on moving round 1 to Sonnet waits for this number.
source: coordinator 23:25 CST Nov 12; deferred note on step rounds-rules-one-record; triage 23:23 CST
note: Read-only measurement, no product change. Sample round-1 FAIL records from the merge tool's review records (both models; only about 43 of about 3,000 round-1 records are Sonnet, so take every Sonnet one). For each FAIL, judge whether a later round or the merged diff fixed the named finding (real) or dropped it with no change (noise). Report per model: records read, FAIL rate, noise share, and the method, as a note here. Then triage posts the owner item (Sonnet round 1 for logic changes) with the numbers.
